label: Baseline
hypothesis: Freeze the original thresholded writer and recency-based retrieval.
predicted_effect: Useful direct facts work; entity and temporal ambiguity remain visible.

proposer.name: Codex
proposer.attribution: Authored by Codex while building this demo, with public access to all scenarios; no runtime provider call.

label: Agent proposal 1
hypothesis: Enabling entity and temporal filtering will remove cross-entity distractors and exclude records outside the requested as-of interval, while deduplication can reduce repeated identical facts without changing answers.
predicted_effect: Higher complete-scenario success, especially for entity grounding and historical/future-date cases; fewer distracting records and lower storage for repeated confirmations.

label: Agent proposal 2
hypothesis: Enabling deduplication will reuse identical active values confirmed on later effective dates, preserving retrieval answers while reducing redundant stored records.
predicted_effect: Complete-scenario success should remain at least unchanged, while storage records and bytes decrease on repeated-confirmation cases; no hard-constraint impact is expected.

label: Agent proposal 3
hypothesis: Lowering min_confidence from 0.7 to 0.6 will admit the demonstrated useful low-confidence fact while preserving the shown abstentions for scores 0.3 and 0.4.
predicted_effect: Increase complete-scenario success by recovering Portuguese in the useful-low-confidence case, with no change to the demonstrated clean-abstention or uncertain-conflict outcomes; other retrieval and storage behavior should remain unchanged.
